user.title: Integration Watchdog
user.description: Reloads the integrations whose entities are all unavailable.

data_description.grace_period: Minutes every entity of an integration must have been unavailable before it is reloaded. Nothing is reloaded during this time after Home Assistant has started.
data_description.grace_overrides: One line per integration: domain: minutes (zha: 30). It replaces the grace period for that integration and the delays between its reloads; after a start, the global grace period still applies to all.
data_description.max_reloads: Reloads of an integration that stays unavailable before giving up on it until it recovers. The delay between two reloads doubles each time: grace period, 2 × grace period…
data_description.ignored_integrations: Integrations never reloaded. Type a domain to add one that isn't set up yet.
data_description.notify_services: Also send each notification with these actions (notify.mobile_app_…). A persistent notification is always created.
data_description.ignored_entries: Single integration entries never reloaded, the other entries of their integration still watched (one camera of several, say).
data_description.pause_entity: While this entity is on (an input_boolean for maintenance, a schedule for the night…), nothing is reloaded; the checks still list the unavailable integrations.

error.invalid_overrides: Each line must be domain: minutes, from 1 to 1440 (zha: 30).

add_power_cycle.title: Power cycle a device
add_power_cycle.description: When all the entities of a device stay unavailable, the smart plug that powers it is switched off, then on again. Same limits as the reloads: reloads in a row, doubling delay, pause entity, nothing during the grace period after a start.

data_description.device_id: The device to restart: all its enabled entities must be unavailable.
data_description.switch: The switch that powers it. Only switched off when it is on: a plug that is off or unavailable is left alone.
data_description.delay: Minutes all the device's entities must have been unavailable before its plug is switched off. The delay between two power cycles doubles each time.
data_description.off_time: Seconds the plug stays off before being switched on again.

error.invalid_overrides: Each line must be domain: minutes, from 1 to 1440 (zha: 30).
error.device_already_cycled: This device already has a power cycle: remove it first.
error.switch_on_device: The plug can't be an entity of the device itself: it would be unavailable with it.
error.device_without_entities: This device has no entity to watch besides the plug.

check.name: Check integrations
check.description: Looks for the integrations whose entities are all unavailable and reloads those past the grace period.

reset.name: Reset an integration
reset.description: Forgets the reloads done on an integration (given up on or not) and reloads it now.

entry_id.name: Integration entry
entry_id.description: The integration entry to reset and reload.

common.reloaded: {title} ({domain}) was reloaded: all its entities were unavailable since {since}. Reload {attempt}/{max}.
common.reload_failed: {title} ({domain}) could not be reloaded: all its entities were unavailable since {since}. Reload {attempt}/{max}, see the logs.
common.gave_up: {title} ({domain}) is still unavailable after {attempt} reloads. It won't be reloaded again until one of its entities is available.
common.power_cycled: {title} was restarted with {switch}: all its entities were unavailable since {since}. Power cycle {attempt}/{max}.
common.power_cycle_failed: {title} could not be restarted with {switch}: all its entities were unavailable since {since}. Power cycle {attempt}/{max}, see the logs.
common.power_cycle_gave_up: {title} is still unavailable after {attempt} power cycles. {switch} won't be switched off again until one of its entities is available.

reload_failed.message: {title} could not be reloaded, see the logs. Its reloads were reset: Integration Watchdog starts over.

confirm.description:
**{title}** ({domain}) is still unavailable after {attempt} reloads by Integration Watchdog, which won't reload it again until one of its entities is available.

Check the device or service it connects to, and the logs. This issue goes away once the integration has recovered.

Submit to try again now: Integration Watchdog forgets its reloads and reloads the integration.

abort.reload_started: Reloading **{title}**: its reloads were reset and Integration Watchdog starts over. This issue goes away as soon as the reload starts; a failure is in the logs.
